Asked who is most honourable, the Prophet says the most righteous, then Joseph, a prophet son of prophets, and among Arabs those best before Islam, if they understand religion.
Asked who is most honourable, the Prophet says the most Allah-fearing, then Joseph, a prophet son of prophets, and among Arabs those best before Islam, if they understand religion.
Joseph is the honourable son of the honourable Jacob, son of Isaac, son of Abraham; asked who is most honourable, the Prophet names the most Allah-fearing, then Joseph.
Joseph, son of Jacob, son of Isaac, son of Abraham, is the honourable son of honourable fathers.
Asked who is the most honourable of people, the Prophet said the most righteous, and when they said that was not their question, Joseph, the prophet of Allah.
Joseph is the honourable son of honourable prophets back to Abraham; asked who is most honourable, the Prophet named the pious, Joseph, then those best before Islam who understand it.
Had he stayed in prison as long as Joseph and then been summoned by the messenger, the Prophet said, he would have answered the call.
